## J03 — Analytics Engineer — Lattice Orchard Software
Source [J03-SRC]: https://careers.example.com/lattice-orchard/analytics-engineer (fictional posting dated 2026-09-03).
Company: fictional US B2B subscription workflow software business; its fictional Billing Insights team supports product and finance.
Location/authorization: fully remote US, explicitly including Illinois; US work authorization required, sponsorship unavailable. Core collaboration 10:00–15:00 Central. Travel at most 5% for planned team meetings.
Level: mid-level IC, 3–6 years relevant experience, no direct reports or staff-level ownership.
Base salary: USD 140,000–160,000; full-time employment.
Work: build subscription-event and revenue/retention marts; define metrics with finance and product; deliver reliable self-service dashboards; reduce warehouse cost and transformation latency; write readable documentation and investigate data defects.
Required: production SQL, dbt Core, Snowflake, incremental and dimensional modeling, schema/business-rule tests, Git pull requests and CI, Python for batch analysis, stakeholder communication. Looker dashboard experience is valuable.
Preferred, not required: Airflow familiarity and B2B billing-domain exposure. Airflow is maintained by a platform team; this role can learn it on the job. No Spark, Java, Kubernetes or ML requirement.
Hiring process: 30-minute hiring-lead conversation, SQL/dbt exercise, and cross-functional metrics discussion. Recruiting requests a ONE-PAGE resume and short cover letter explaining two relevant contributions. No referral, interview invitation, or application outcome has occurred.
